articles.summary: Furthering its commitment to empower businesses with AI-driven payments infrastructure, Cashfree Payments announced the launch of Agentic Payments at the Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2025, a groundbreaking solution that embeds the entire online shopping experience inside a chat without redirects or pop-ups.
articles.title: Cashfree Payments Becomes One Of The First Fintechs In India To Unveil Agentic Payments, Bringing End-to-End AI Commerce Inside Chat
